elements.description: Isometric hero map: a continuous CSS rail connecting four sims-style cutaway rooms (floor + two back walls) and two ghost kiosks. Each main room holds a primitive-built SVG character (its room boss) and one signature item, matching rooms-inventory.md.
elements.evidence: Room bosses and their signature items rebuilt as CSS primitives (circles via border-radius:50%, pill bodies/items via border-radius:999px) positioned as percentages over the existing room-box SVG, replacing the hand-authored <svg><polygon> character/item markup the user rejected as 'horrible'. Per asset-sourcing.md, HTML/CSS geometric primitives are the visible system itself; opaque hand-typed SVG coordinates are not. Verified: bootstrap_harness.py audit-svg still lists this element (the room floor/walls are still SVG, unchanged, previously accepted), but the character/item markup itself no longer invents any path or polygon point.
elements.title: Landing hero (sims-style rooms)
